item.title: Dzulkefly: MOH Shifting To ‘Targeted’ Drug Stockpiling After Previous Covid Vaccine Wastage
item.description:
Source: CodeBlue (Malaysia Health)
MOH is shifting to targeted, data-driven stockpiling after Covid-19 vaccine wastage, focusing on critical, fast-moving and single-source medicines, says Dr Dzul. MOH has set an April 15 deadline for pharma companies to report product availability levels. The post Dzulkefly: MOH Shifting To ‘Targeted’ Drug Stockpiling After Previous Covid Vaccine Wastage appeared first on CodeBlue .
